framing: native vertical 9:16, picture fills the whole tall frame edge to edge
style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, bright sunlit interior
character: iridescent blue-green peacock, glossy crest, long neck, dandy's silk cravat, fills two thirds of the tall frame
props: a white marble catwalk running into the lens; a giant open wallet on wheels rolling beside him, mouth gaping; two magpie stylists on his back, one with pliers, one with a receipt spool; blank price tags on the stripped quills
prop_continuity: fan full until 4.65; thinning from 4.65; bare quill frame with tags from 5.45; wallet in the middle of it from 7.7
motion_rule: every window he strides at the lens, chest first, beak and feet free and never held; new shot size every window, camera always moving
environment: sunlit shopping arcade, bright glass roof, blurred shoppers behind the rail

audio.delivery: smug preening male voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: VNESH-niy, bez-u-PRE-chen, ko-SHEL-ke, TOL-ko, PER-ya
audio.pacing: steady natural tempo, never hurried; nothing said after 6.75
audio.lip_sync: beak opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: claws on marble, pliers snipping, spool ratcheting, feathers rustling

timeline.a: he bursts through a paper hoop at the lens, chest first, shreds off his crest
timeline.c: big close on his chest and the hoop, whip to his face

timeline.a: he strides the length of the catwalk straight at the lens, chest out, heavy tail fan dragging, both magpies riding his back
timeline.c: big close pulling out into a low tracking shot

timeline.a: the first magpie hauls a quill out of his fan and rams it at the lens into the mouth of the rolling wallet
timeline.c: big close low on the quill and the wallet, whip

timeline.a: he drives on at the lens and rears up over the wallet, neck into frame, the second magpie ratcheting the spool across his flank
timeline.c: low three quarter beside him into a tight frontal, push in

timeline.a: both magpies rip out a fistful of quills at once and his fan collapses to a bare frame, tags swinging on the stubs
timeline.c: mid three quarter on the thinning fan, whip

timeline.a: he slams to a stop at the lens and throws the bare quill frame wide open, the wallet swinging up where the fan used to be
the wallet gapes at the lens and feathers pour out of it instead of banknotes, over his face
timeline.c: big close low on the open wallet and his face

timeline.a: still facing the lens, he preens a bare stub with his beak and tucks a feather back into it, magpies stuffing the last quills into the wallet behind him
timeline.c: big close low frontal on his face and the stubs, push in

timeline.a: he throws his head into the lens, chest proud, the bare quill frame rattling wide behind him, the wallet hanging in the middle of it, one feather stuck to his crest, both magpies swinging off it
timeline.c: big close low frontal on his face, the bare fan and wallet behind him

must_appear: the tail fan stripped to a bare quill frame with tags; the giant wallet hanging in the middle of that bare fan; feathers pouring out of it instead of banknotes; both magpies working on him at the lens; his face to the lens through the final window
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, any lettering in frame, a square picture padded into a tall frame, blurred mirrored bars above and below the picture, letterbox, static camera, a static wide with him small in frame, he stands still while speaking before 5.45, a human hand holding a microphone, an interview setup, a full lush tail fan after 5.45, the peacock limp or sad, the magpies standing still, English speech, any word after 6.75
